scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run build -w shared && npm run check -w server && npm run check -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.dev:solo: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
